title: Up on the roofs
subtitle: Ladders, roofs and the jump between them.

sections.name: Street
sections.note: A street of flat-roofed houses: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstLadder
sections.note: The first ladder: run into it and she climbs; along the roofs, and off the end.

sections.name: FirstGap
sections.note: Two rows with a 1.2 m gap: jump across. A feather above the gap.

sections.name: Neem
sections.note: Back on the road: a neem's low limb across it. Slide.

sections.name: CotUp
sections.note: A rope cot pushed against a house with no ladder: run into it and bounce up onto its roof.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: RoofTank
sections.note: A long row with a water tank on the roof: jump it up there. Dung after the drop.

sections.name: GapGap
sections.note: Three rows, two gaps.

sections.name: SandHens
sections.note: A house going up: a heap of its sand in the road, then two hens.

sections.name: CotUpGap
sections.note: The cot up onto a roof (a feather above the wall), a gap, and a tank on the next roof.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: DogNeem
sections.note: The dog asleep in the dust, then a neem's low limb.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: Dung; then the rooster knocks the hens' basket off a doorstep into the road.

sections.name: RoofTrain
sections.note: Four rows in a train, a tank on the third: jump, jump, jump, and down.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A breather and a chilli.

sections.name: PumpGoatDog
sections.note: The hand pump's puddle, a goat kid, the dog.

sections.name: CotRoofs
sections.note: The cot up, a long row with a tank on it, a gap, and down.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastRow
sections.note: The last ladder, a long row, and down onto the open road.

sections.name: OpenLane
sections.note: The lane opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 290 m.
